source: a replay re-runs its replay block's whole batch from the block's edge state in the served batch layout, at 0.97-1.02x serving's busy GPU-seconds (measured on Moonlight at 1x H200 and on GLM-5.3 at TP8, mid-traffic); GLM-5.3 replays bit-exact at TP8 with the deterministic DSA top-k, so a sampled request costs its replay block's whole batch unless kernels are batch-invariant
